title: Hubble: a Model Suite to Advance the Study of LLM Memorization
authors_zh: Johnny Tian-Zheng Wei, Ameya Godbole, Mohammad Aflah Khan, Ryan Wang, Xiaoyuan Zhu, James Flemings, Nitya Kashyap, Krishna P. Gummadi, Willie Neiswanger, Robin Jia
paper_type_zh: 大模型记忆、隐私与测试集污染的受控模型套件
best_for_zh: 研究成员推断、模型遗忘、隐私泄漏或测试集污染的研究者。
one_line: Controlled paired LLMs with injected text and test sets make memorization and contamination experiments reproducible.
以可控文本插入的开源配对模型，将记忆与污染研究变为可复现的因果实验。
why: It supplies an inspectable testbed for measuring when sensitive text is memorized and for evaluating mitigations.
inclusion_reason: Open controlled model suite for measuring memorization, privacy leakage, copyright risk, and test-set contamination.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Controlled memorization studies are often too small to resemble modern LLMs, while observational studies of large models cannot identify why a text was memorized. This leaves copyright, privacy, and benchmark-contamination interventions difficult to measure causally.

Hubble releases matched open models trained with deliberate, randomized text insertions. It turns duplication, placement in training, and data type into known treatments, so researchers can measure memorization and test mitigation methods rather than infer training exposure from a black box.

受控记忆研究往往模型过小，难以代表现代 LLM；直接观察大模型又无法判定文本为何被记住。因此，版权、隐私和测试集污染的干预很难获得因果度量。

Hubble 发布带有刻意、随机文本插入的开源配对模型，把重复次数、训练中的放置位置和数据类型变为已知处理因素。研究者因而可以测量记忆并检验缓解方法，而非从黑箱输出猜测训练暴露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Hubble is a fully open suite of paired Llama-style models: standard models train on a fixed English corpus, and perturbed counterparts receive controlled insertions covering copyright passages, biographies and chats, and test sets. Its core 2×2×2 release contains eight 1B/8B models trained on 100B/500B tokens, plus timing and auxiliary runs. The feedback contract is known membership and duplicate count, enabling causal evaluations of extraction, membership inference, unlearning, and contamination. Models, datasets, and code are released through the official project.
Hubble 是一套完全开源的配对 Llama 风格模型：标准组在固定英文语料上训练，扰动组额外接收可控插入的版权段落、传记与对话、测试集。核心 2×2×2 发布含八个 1B/8B、100B/500B token 模型，并附带时序和辅助实验。已知的成员关系与重复次数构成反馈契约，可因果评测抽取、成员推断、遗忘和污染；模型、数据集和代码均由官方项目发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare a clean base corpus. The authors use DCLM-derived English data, remove perturbation overlap, and retain this corpus for standard models.
  1. Define interventions. They sample passages, paraphrases, biographies, chats, and test items, assigning examples 0×, 1×, 4×, 16×, 64×, or 256× duplication.
  1. Create perturbed sequences. Each selected item is spliced between documents in a 2048-token training sequence, bounded by EOS markers; the 100B-token perturbations total 79.9M tokens.
  1. Train matched suites. Llama-style 1B and 8B models are trained at 100B or 500B tokens, with core, timing, interference, paraphrase, and architecture variants.
  1. Measure exposure. Domain-specific extraction and benchmark tests compare standard and perturbed models. Verify exact training checkpoints, Hugging Face revisions, and compute settings before reproduction.

1. 准备干净底座。作者使用源自 DCLM 的英文语料，移除与扰动材料的重叠，作为标准组训练语料。
  1. 定义干预。对段落、改写、传记、对话和测试题采样，并赋予 0×、1×、4×、16×、64×、256× 的重复次数。
  1. 构造扰动序列。将条目插在 2048 token 训练序列的文档之间，以 EOS 包围；100B 设置的扰动共 79.9M token。
  1. 训练配对套件。训练 1B、8B 的 100B/500B token Llama 风格模型，并提供核心、时序、干扰、改写和结构变体。
  1. 测量暴露。用领域评测比较标准组与扰动组；复现前须核对检查点、Hugging Face 版本和计算配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: memorization depends on a sensitive text's frequency relative to corpus size and on when it appears. The core experiment holds architecture and perturbation design fixed while comparing 1B/8B models, standard versus perturbed data, and 100B versus 500B tokens. Figure 2 shows weaker memorization at the same duplication level after 500B than after 100B tokens; timing runs show that text inserted earlier and followed by further training is more readily forgotten. These controlled results support dilution and early placement as mitigations within Hubble's corpus and architecture, not as a guarantee for proprietary training pipelines.
核心主张是记忆取决于敏感文本相对语料规模的频率及其出现时间。核心实验固定架构和扰动设计，对比 1B/8B、标准/扰动、100B/500B token。图2显示同一重复级别下，500B token 训练后的记忆弱于 100B；时序实验显示，较早插入并经历后续训练的文本更易被遗忘。该受控证据支持在 Hubble 语料和架构内采用稀释与早期放置，不能保证适用于专有训练管线。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior controlled work used small synthetic settings, while suites such as Pythia expose training dynamics without known interventions for diverse sensitive texts. Hubble changes the data object: paired, larger open models differ by randomized and quantified insertions across copyright, privacy, and contamination domains. This makes duplicate frequency and insertion time causal variables rather than post-hoc hypotheses. The model architecture and standard capability evaluation are not themselves new; the reusable contribution is the controlled release and its linked evaluations.
既有受控研究多为小型合成设置，Pythia 一类套件虽公开训练动态，却没有覆盖多类敏感文本的已知干预。Hubble 改变的是数据对象：较大的开源配对模型只相差随机且量化的版权、隐私、污染插入，使重复频率与插入时机成为因果变量，而非事后假设。模型架构和通用能力评测并非新意；可复用贡献是受控发布及其连接的评测。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Hubble's inserted examples are deliberately designed treatments, not a sample of undocumented web-scale leakage; results may differ under naturally correlated repetition or data mixtures. The suite uses Llama-style 1B and 8B models and a specific English corpus, so its dilution and ordering effects need not transfer to other architectures, languages, or post-training pipelines. Reusers should check the perturbation dataset, duplication schedule, and evaluation format before interpreting a difference as a real-world privacy or contamination rate.
Hubble 的插入样本是刻意设计的处理因素，并非无文档网页级泄漏的随机样本；自然相关的重复和数据混合可能产生不同结果。套件使用特定英文语料及 1B、8B 的 Llama 风格模型，稀释与排序效应未必迁移到其他架构、语言或后训练流程。复用者应检查扰动数据、重复计划和评测格式，不能把差异直接解释为真实世界的隐私或污染率。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A memorization researcher can use a standard/perturbed pair and its known member labels to evaluate membership inference or extraction without natural-data confounders. An unlearning researcher can use the biographies, duplicate counts, and matched models to test whether removal works at different memorization strengths. The output is a controlled measurement curve rather than an estimate of a production model's training corpus. Do not use Hubble as evidence that a particular proprietary model trained on a named document; it supplies experimental counterfactuals, not provenance.
记忆研究者可利用标准/扰动模型对及其已知成员标签，在不受自然数据混杂影响的条件下评测成员推断或抽取。遗忘研究者可利用传记、重复次数和配对模型，检查不同记忆强度下的删除效果。输出是受控测量曲线，而非生产模型训练语料的估计；不能据此断定某个专有模型训练过某篇文档，它提供的是实验反事实而不是来源证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: Hubble makes memorization risks experimentally measurable with known training interventions.
  • Mechanism: paired standard and perturbed models vary duplicate count, corpus size, and insertion time.
  • Artifact: the project releases models, perturbation datasets, and code; core models span 1B/8B parameters and 100B/500B tokens.
  • Evidence anchor: Figure 2 finds dilution at larger corpus size, and timing runs show later exposure is retained more strongly.
  • Reuse decision: use the known member labels for inference or unlearning evaluation; verify the exact dataset revision before comparison.

• 定位：Hubble 用已知训练干预让记忆风险可以实验测量。
  • 方法抓手：标准/扰动配对模型改变重复次数、语料规模和插入时机。
  • 数据与材料：项目公开模型、扰动数据集和代码；核心模型覆盖 1B/8B 参数与 100B/500B token。
  • 证据锚点：图2显示较大语料产生稀释效应，时序实验显示较晚暴露保留更强。
  • 复用决定：可用已知成员标签评测推断或遗忘；比较前先核对精确数据版本。
